t: The Fluidizer is a 3x3x3 (minimum size) machine built from Casing blocks and a mix of the other device parts.$(br)Glass can be used in place of Casing blocks on all faces of the machine (but not on the frame).$(br2)Check each Fluidizer part page for restrictions on where each part can be placed.
流化器是一种由机壳方块和其他设备部件混合搭建而成的 3x3x3（最小尺寸）机器。$(br)机器所有面都可以用玻璃替代机壳方块（但框架不能替代）。$(br2)请查看各个流化器部件页面，了解每个部件可放置位置的限制。
